spells/flaywind-burst-3156.name: Flaywind Burst
spells/flaywind-burst-3156.effectSummary: Creates a 60-foot cone of roughly 70-mph supernatural sandstorm winds. Creatures take 1d6 damage per caster level, maximum 10d6, Reflex half, and separately make Fortitude saves against the wind: Small or smaller creatures are knocked down and rolled 1d4×10 feet for 1d4 nonlethal damage per 10 feet, or if flying are blown back 2d6×10 feet for 2d6 nonlethal; Medium creatures are knocked prone or, if flying, blown back 1d6×10 feet; Large or Huge creatures cannot move forward or, if flying, are blown back 1d6×5 feet; Gargantuan or larger creatures move normally. The burst cannot move creatures beyond its range and can briefly produce other windstorm-force sandstorm effects such as obscuring vision, heeling boats, and dispersing gases. Material component: sand and a vulture wing feather.

spells/investiture-of-the-amnizu-1174.name: Investiture of the Amnizu
spells/investiture-of-the-amnizu-1174.effectSummary: Grants fire resistance 5, immunity to effects that damage, drain, or otherwise reduce Intelligence, and a melee touch attack usable once per two caster levels; each touch is a standard action and deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. The subject is treated as vulnerable to evil-outsider-bane weapons, gains the listed fire resistance which stacks with other different evil investiture spells but not another copy of itself, and becomes fatigued for 1 minute when the spell ends. Material component: a fist-sized chunk of brimstone.
spells/investiture-of-the-amnizu-1174.notes: Manually reviewed as part of the complete Fiendish Codex II evil-investiture family; shared bane, stacking-resistance, post-duration fatigue, and brimstone-component rules are preserved.

spells/investiture-of-the-barbed-devil-1.name: Investiture of the Barbed Devil
spells/investiture-of-the-barbed-devil-1.effectSummary: Grants fire resistance 10 and barbs. Initiating a grapple no longer provokes attacks of opportunity; if the subject already has improved grab or Improved Grapple, it instead gains +4 profane on grapple checks. Each successful grapple check to grab, pin, or deal damage also inflicts size-based barb damage. The subject is treated as vulnerable to evil-outsider-bane weapons, gains the listed fire resistance which stacks with other different evil investiture spells but not another copy of itself, and becomes fatigued for 1 minute when the spell ends. Material component: a fist-sized chunk of brimstone.

spells/investiture-of-the-erinyes-1178.effectSummary: Grants fire resistance 5 and a beckoning compulsion usable once per three caster levels against a clearly seen creature. On a failed Will save, that creature's next action can only be movement toward the subject, although it will not take obviously suicidal movement; once adjacent, it takes no further action that round. spells/investiture-of-the-pit-fiend-1186.effectSummary: Grants fly speed 60 feet with average maneuverability, immunity to poison, and fire resistance 20.
